posts.text: Today company has announced a MoU with Aethrone Aerospace, a Pune-based aerospace/defence design, engineering and composite manufacturing company. Jointly will explore setting up a precision manufacturing facility in New Mexico, USA, targeting Tier-1/2/3 aerospace and defence supply chains, OEMs, and commercial/general aviation clients.
